questions.question: One utility large-load rule in the warehouse has the status "denied". Which utility's is it?
questions.answer: policy_actions: license needed, so no figure of it is given here. Not in the warehouse. No large-load rule has the status "denied". The only table of utility large-load statements, large_load_public (model-extracted), has 341 rows. Their statuses are six values: 1 request or inquiry (49 rows), 2 study or engineering (52), 3 financial commitment (2), 4 signed service agreement (27), 5 under construction or energized (34), and not classed (177). A filter on status "denied" returned 0 rows. The policy_actions table might hold such a ruling, but it is held for a license and I could not read it.
